item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
The ONS MAP Mediation Program provides borough-based conflict mediation services for as an alternative to court involvement, enabling parties to voluntarily resolve disputes and reach mutually agreed-upon outcomes while preventing escalation of conflict and potential violence. DYCD seeks approval to use the Negotiated Acquisition method in accordance with PPB Rule §3-04 (b) (2) (i) (C). This approach allows the agency to negotiate directly with a qualified community-based organization (CBO) while ensuring there is no gap in the operation of these critical services.
